name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines

fees.name: Entry visa (Ministry of National Security / Foreign Affairs)
fees.applies: visa-required nationalities (Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Cameroon, China, Dominican Republic, Haiti, Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Nepal, Nigeria, Syria)
fees.notes: Non-refundable local fee of EC$200.00. Application is made to the Ministry of National Security in St. Vincent; Foreign Affairs arranges interview with sponsor. XCD is pegged at 2.70 per USD (~USD 74). No separate published business or transit visa fee schedule found on official sources.

free_visa_notes: Most nationalities (180+ countries) enter Saint Vincent and the Grenadines visa-free, typically for stays up to 90 days. Only a short list of nationalities requires an entry visa. There is no e-visa, eTA, or visa-on-arrival fee regime.
